title: PatchProposal@1 payload
description: An ATOMIC proposed change set, not a bag of independently selectable hunks. A proposal is a claim about a fix; it never resolves a Finding by itself — only positive derived-snapshot verification does. Automatic application is granted by the Reviewer Binding alone: a reviewer may nominate, and cannot infer eligibility from its own severity or confidence.

base_snapshot_id.description: Exact snapshot the patch applies to. Validation rejects a proposal whose base is not the snapshot the attempt reviewed.

patch_artifact_id.description: Content object holding the patch itself.

finding_refs.description: The exact claims this patch covers. A same-attempt proposal cannot know the canonical Finding ID assigned after reduction, so a Report ID from the same selected attempt is accepted and mapped deterministically at the later ledger barrier.

evidence_ids.description: Evidence artifacts supporting the fix — a reproduced failure, a red-first test, a measurement.

paths.description: Declared path set. Must equal the paths the patch actually changes; a declared set differing from the computed diff makes the proposal ineligible for automatic application.

description.description: What the patch does and why it is the right fix.

auto_apply_nominated.description: The attempt nominates this proposal for automatic integration. At most one per attempt in v1, and the patch must equal the kernel-computed final sandbox diff byte-for-byte after canonical normalization — diagnostic mutations must be reverted before completion. A nomination is a request; the binding's patch policy decides.
